title: Cambridge IELTS 15 Academic Speaking Test 2
description: Haqiqiy IELTS/CEFR Speaking formati: Rasmiy Cambridge IELTS 15 Test 2 bo‘yicha Part 1 (Kirish va kundalik mavzular), Part 2 (Cue Card taqdimot) va Part 3 (Tahliliy munozara).

sections.title: Speaking Assessment (Parts 1-3)
sections.instructions: Ushbu bo‘lim 3 ta qismdan iborat. Har bir qism topshirig‘i bilan tanishib chiqing, tayyor bo‘lgach mikrofon tugmasini bosib ovozingizni yozing va saqlang.

questions.question_text:
Part 1: Introduction & Everyday Topics (Speak for 1-2 minutes)

1. How many languages can you speak? [Why/why not?]
2. How useful will English be to you in your future? [Why/why not?]
3. What do you remember about learning languages at school? [Why/why not?]
4. What do you think would be the hardest language for you to learn? [Why?]

Part 2: Individual Long Turn / Cue Card (1 minute preparation, 2 minutes speaking)

Describe a website that you bought something from.
You should say:
• What the website is
• What you bought from this website
• How satisfied you were with what you bought
And explain what you liked or disliked about using this website.

Part 3: Two-way Discussion (Speak for 2-3 minutes)

1. What kinds of things do people in your country often buy from online shops?
2. Why do you think online shopping has become so popular nowadays?
3. What are some possible disadvantages of buying things from online shops?
4. Why do many people today keep buying things which they do not need?
5. Do you believe the benefits of a consumer society outweigh the disadvantages?
6. How possible is it to avoid the culture of consumerism?
